title: UNESCO partners with Coursera and launches free AI ethics course, developed in collaboration with LG AI Research, for learners and institutions worldwide
content:
Today, I’m proud to welcome UNESCO, the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization, to Coursera as they launch their first free course, the Global MOOC on the Ethics of AI, which they built with LG AI Research.

The post UNESCO partners with Coursera and launches free AI ethics course, developed in collaboration with LG AI Research, for learners and institutions worldwide appeared first on Coursera Blog.
